scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: This is the sole candidate passing all frozen hard gates. The significant immune transition is spatially coherent, with complete contained nuclei and preserved protected structures despite a marked population increase.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 82,116-pixel joint change forms connected authorized stroma-to-immune regions; its 76,667-pixel tissue component remains above the 70,779-pixel hard floor and is the certified batch maximum-safe result.
decisions.nucleus_layout: The 102 class-2 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.903, 1.296, 0.919 and 1.166.
decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei remain inside authorized changed tissue; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density checks pass with score 0.897.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The target population is more numerous, denser and more clustered than source, though within the frozen significant envelope. The certified maximum-safe joint area (82,116 pixels) is just below the nominal desired interval but above the hard floor under the predeclared fallback. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 03 as the single mask-condition handoff, retaining the density and maximum-safe fallback limitations.
